purpose: Orchestrates the complete annotation pipeline for a single badminton video, coordinating segmentation (finding rally spans), contact detection, rally verdict determination, landing prediction, and hit-height measurement to produce a comprehensive analysis without ground truth.

public_api.name: scoring_filter
public_api.role: Filters contacts to keep only rows the scorer reads: wrist gate not failed, not suppressed.

public_api.name: build_serve_options
public_api.role: Builds serve-start detection options from the unmasked sticky cache, used to configure serve evidence collection.

public_api.name: run_video
public_api.role: Main entry point that runs the full annotation pipeline for one video, returning AnnotatorResult with all detected spans, contacts, verdicts, landings, and measurements.

public_api.name: AnnotatorResult
public_api.role: NamedTuple holding all outputs from the pipeline: rally spans, raw and filtered contacts, striker assignments, verdicts, landings, and hit-height data.

public_api.name: RunCapture
public_api.role: Dataclass for caller-owned copies of exclusion masks and landing diagnostics generated during one run.

public_api.name: LandingHorizonRow
public_api.role: Frozen dataclass representing a single GT-free comparison of landing outcomes at different time horizons.
